issues.source_quote: Ну что же это такое... - Ну разве можно!...
issues.translation_quote: Oh! What on earth... - You can't do that!
issues.justification: Minor; but more importantly the exchange is fine. (Low priority.)

issues.source_quote: Фрис-стрит, рыбна улица, - Аптека «Чиканук»...
issues.translation_quote: Fris Street, Rybnaya Street, - Chikanuk Pharmacy...
issues.justification: The garbled, nonsensical pseudo-foreign cover phrases are transliterated without any signal that they are code/password material; the joke of the spy ritual is not conveyed.

issues.source_quote: Поскользнулся, упал... Закрытый перелом... Потерял сознание, очнулся - гипс.
issues.translation_quote: Slipped, fell... closed fracture... Blacked out. Woke up— in a cast.
issues.justification: The iconic catchphrase is rendered inconsistently across the film ("Slipped. Fell..." vs "Slipped, fell..."), weakening the running gag's repetition.

issues.source_quote: Дичь! Он определил летний ресторан «Плакучая Ива» ... туалэт, типа сортир, обозначенный на схеме буквами «Мэ» и «Жо».
issues.translation_quote: marked on the diagram "M" and "W."
issues.justification: The Russian М and Ж (men/women) joke is mistranslated; "M" and "W" loses the deliberately pompous, bureaucratic comedy and the "Мэ"/"Жо" pronunciation.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets, and you may win a... Waterworks!
issues.justification: The rhyme (пачку/водокачку) that makes the slogan comic is lost entirely.

issues.source_quote: Куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.translation_quote: strike while the iron's hot— without leaving the cash register!
issues.justification: Acceptable as a literal blend, but the established English rendering of the pun is not fully natural; the blend is retained and works. Minor risk.

issues.source_quote: Они, конечно, предложат большой выкуп, а я ещё поторгуюсь.
issues.translation_quote: They'll offer a large ransom, of course, and I'll haggle.
issues.justification: Wordplay of "живец / сам рыбак" is rendered as "I'm the bait... I'm a fisherman myself," which is contradictory and confusing; the logic of the joke is muddled.

issues.source_quote: Ах, он такой доверчивый... А-аа!... рука... Его пытали!
issues.translation_quote: They recruited him! But how could he? Oh, he's so trusting...
issues.justification: Mostly fine; the humor of the building manager's ideological paranoia is preserved.

issues.source_quote: Простите, пожалуйста... - Здравствуйте... Старший экономист в "Гипрорыбе".
issues.translation_quote: Senior economist at Giproryba.
issues.justification: The institute name is left untranslated without any cue that it is a state design institute for the fishing industry; minor cultural loss.

issues.source_quote: Нет, я никуда не еду. Мы провожаем папу!!!
issues.translation_quote: No, I'm not going anywhere. We're seeing Daddy off!
issues.justification: Fine; but the preceding interviewer lines are merged, making the sequence of speakers hard to follow.

issues.source_quote: Нет, нет, нет, нет, нет! А я взял... Водку?
issues.translation_quote: Did you bring any souvenirs? No, no, no, no, no! I did... Vodka?
issues.justification: Lost speaker clarity; the gag that Gorbunkov was shown to be an innocent while Kozodoyev implies vodka is flattened.

issues.source_quote: Нынадо... Иди...
issues.translation_quote: Don't... Go on...
issues.justification: "Не надо" is garbled in the source (comic mishearing); translation neutralises it.

issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, если человек идиот - то это надолго.
issues.translation_quote: if a man's an idiot, it's for life.
issues.justification: The recurring boss-aphorism formula is rendered fine; no issue. (Low priority.)

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках! Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: May you drop dead! May I see you in your coffin, wearing white slippers! May you have to live on your salary alone!
issues.justification: The neighbor's ungrammatical, Odessa-flavored curse ("у гробу, у белых тапках") loses its dialect colour in standard English.

issues.source_quote: Собака друг человека! ... Управдом - друг человека!
issues.translation_quote: the building manager is man's best friend!
issues.justification: Acceptable; the contrast is preserved.

issues.source_quote: Ты зачем усы сбрил? ... Вылитый Володька Трынкин!
issues.translation_quote: Why did you shave off your mustache? ... Volodya Trynkin!
issues.justification: The scene works; the name Trynkin links to "трынь-трава" (don't care), which the song translation renders as "tryn-grass", an opaque coinage that kills the idiom "трын-трава" (it's all nothing to us).

issues.source_quote: Все напасти нам будут трынь трава.
issues.translation_quote: All troubles will be tryn-grass to us.
issues.justification: "Тринь-трава" idiom (meaning 'nothing, no big deal') is rendered as meaningless "tryn-grass"; the song's central pun is lost.

issues.source_quote: Остров Невезения ... Видно, в понедельник их мама родила.
issues.translation_quote: Their mothers must have borne them on a Monday morn.
issues.justification: Acceptable song rendering; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Они Вас услышат. Оружие при Вас? Психическое...
issues.translation_quote: Do you have your weapon? Psychological...
issues.justification: Original is "Вас услышат" with the wire; line "We'll hear you" lacks clarity but meaning preserved.

issues.source_quote: Пятый, пятый, он вошёл, приём!
issues.translation_quote: Five, Five, he's gone in. Over!
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Это - я, я, я!
issues.translation_quote: That's me! Me!
issues.justification: Minor fidelity detail.

issues.source_quote: [Дальше следует непереводимая игра слов, с использованием местных идиоматических выражений.]
issues.translation_quote: [What follows is untranslatable wordplay involving local idiomatic expressions.]
issues.justification: Fine; faithful.

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No, I can't agree to that!
issues.justification: The deliberately dialectal "пойтить" (Lyolik's mock-rustic speech while impersonating) is flattened.

issues.source_quote: Ну, ни пуха Вам, ни пера! К чёрту, к чёрту!
issues.translation_quote: Well, break a leg! To hell with that!
issues.justification: "To hell with that!" misrenders the ritual reply "К чёрту!" (to hell with you / thanks), changing the meaning to a refusal.

issues.source_quote: Усё так, как условились.
issues.translation_quote: Just as we agreed.
issues.justification: Lyolik's pseudo-Ukrainian/Odessan "усё" quirk is dropped, flattening character voice.

issues.source_quote: Сядем усе!
issues.translation_quote: We're all going to prison!
issues.justification: The final line's slangy, comic "сядем усе" (we'll all be jailed) is rendered flat; also loses Lyolik's idiosyncratic speech.

issues.source_quote: [фигня]
issues.translation_quote: C-crap...
issues.justification: Register slightly too coarse and awkward for 1960s Soviet wife; "Rubbish" would be more fitting.

issues.source_quote: Ну что Вы, время! Время - деньги!
issues.translation_quote: There's no time! Time is money!
issues.justification: The pun-linked "Куй железо" setup needs the same phrase; fine.

issues.source_quote: Кемедэн райн, джёс сви ми Михаил Светлов?
issues.translation_quote: Kemeden rain, jos vi mi Mikhail Svetlov?
issues.justification: Transliterated pseudo-foreign gibberish retains Cyrillic-style spellings (e.g., "Tsigel") not clearly signalling fake language to the English viewer.

issues.source_quote: Хорошо, что он не контрабандист, симпатичный мужик...
issues.translation_quote: I'm glad he's not a smuggler. A nice fellow...
issues.justification: Register slightly formal for colloquial "мужик".
